description: This PHP script interacts with Redmine issue tracker API, performing operations such as retrieving project and issue details, and creating new issues via XML payloads.

classes.name: redmine
classes.description: A class for interacting with the Redmine API, including methods for retrieving projects, issues, and creating issues.

methods.name: __construct
methods.description: Initializes the redmine object with URL and API key.

methods.name: getProjects
methods.description: Retrieves list of projects from Redmine.

methods.name: getIssue
methods.description: Fetches details of a specific issue by its number.

methods.name: addIssueFromSimpleXML
methods.description: Creates a new issue in Redmine using a SimpleXMLElement.
